Meaningful gauge.css original conic-gradient plus radial-mask geometry recipe reusable by a future group, not new SVG rendering; appearance/variants/sizes remain existing DS or allowed Tailwind utilities/CVA with seven meaningful files. Approved visual table: preset strokes sm/md/lg 3/4/6px at diameters 40/56/80px; custom numeric stroke diameter/14 including fractions; existing DS brand/warning/danger/muted fill tokens; source foreground track at 10% via tokens and allowed Tailwind opacity, no handwritten new color mix; original centered proportions with 30% inset, no fixed A/caption; Material Surface well semantics, no flat replacement, hover, glows or motion. Component geometry parameters are approved source values, not new canonical tokens; any demonstrated new-token need still requires confirmation.

approval.numericCustomization: Approved: size?: GaugeSize | number; any finite positive CSS-pixel ring diameter including 0.5 or 64.5, with no artificial maximum or positive minimum cutoff. Zero, negatives, NaN and ±Infinity fall back to md (56px). Measurement value alone is clamped to 0–100; non-finite value is unavailable, never fake zero. Static w-[var(--eg-gauge-size)] and h-[var(--eg-gauge-size)] plus numeric CSS-pixel --eg-gauge-size remain limited to diameter geometry; presets use token utilities. No inline appearance or dynamic utility-string interpolation. The conic-gradient/radial-mask exception is geometric, not permission for decorative gradients/shadows or custom appearance.
